t: The $(thing)Pressure Chamber/$ is a multi-block structure used to compress various materials into other materials. Due to its large air storage capacity, it can also serve as a useful "battery".$(p)The following rules for multiblock construction apply:$(li)The overall multiblock must be a hollow 3x3x3, 4x4x4 or 5x5x5 structure.
$(thing)压力室/$是一种多方块结构，用于将各种材料压缩成其他材料。由于它拥有很大的储气容量，也可以充当实用的“电池”。$(p)多方块结构的搭建需遵循以下规则：$(li)整体结构必须是中空的 3x3x3、4x4x4 或 5x5x5 结构。

$(li)The $(thing)edges/$ and $(thing)corners/$ must be either $(item)Pressure Chamber Walls/$ or $(item)Pressure Chamber Glass/$.$(li)The $(thing)faces/$ must be either $(item)Pressure Chamber Walls/$, $(item)Pressure Chamber Glass/$, $(item)Pressure Chamber Valves/$ or $(l:manufacturing/pressure_chamber#interface)Pressure Chamber Interfaces/$.$(li)At least one $(item)Pressure Chamber Valve/$ is required.$(li)At least two $(item)Pressure Chamber Interfaces/$ are recommended (one should face in, one should face out).

$(li)$(thing)边缘/$和$(thing)角落/$必须由$(item)压力室墙壁/$或$(item)压力室玻璃/$构成。$(li)$(thing)各面/$必须由$(item)压力室墙壁/$、$(item)压力室玻璃/$、$(item)压力室气阀/$或$(l:manufacturing/pressure_chamber#interface)压力室接口/$构成。$(li)至少需要一个$(item)压力室气阀/$。$(li)建议至少安装两个$(item)压力室接口/$（一个应朝内，一个应朝外）。
A possible 3x3x3 pressure chamber with 1 $(item)valve/$ and 2 $(item)interfaces/$
一个可行的 3x3x3 压力室，带有 1 个$(item)阀门/$和 2 个$(item)接口/$
A possible 4x4x4 pressure chamber with 2 $(item)valves/$ and 2 $(item)interfaces/$
一个可行的 4x4x4 压力室，带有 2 个$(item)阀门/$和 2 个$(item)接口/$
A possible 5x5x5 pressure chamber with 4 $(item)valves/$ and 4 $(item)interfaces/$
一个可行的 5x5x5 压力室，带有 4 个$(item)阀门/$和 4 个$(item)接口/$

The $(item)Pressure Chamber Interface/$ is used to automate the insertion and extraction of items to the $(thing)Pressure Chamber/$. Items $(italic)must/$ be piped in via $(item)Hoppers/$ or other mod piping systems. You should have at least two interfaces: one with the 'I' facing out (the $(thing)input interface/$), and one with the 'O' facing out (the $(thing)output interface/$).
$(item)压力室接口/$用于自动向$(thing)压力室/$插入和提取物品。物品$(italic)必须/$通过$(item)漏斗/$或其他模组的物流管道系统输入。你至少应该安装两个接口：一个让“I”朝外（即$(thing)输入接口/$），另一个让“O”朝外（即$(thing)输出接口/$）。

Input-mode Interfaces will only accept items which are ingredients for a Pressure Chamber recipe.  Output-mode Interfaces will (by default) only export crafted items, but there is a button in the GUI to allow export of $(italic)all/$ items if you need to.$(p)$(italic)Note that this behaviour has changed since 1.12.2 days and is much more user-friendly now./$
输入模式的接口只会接收可作为压力室配方材料的物品。输出模式的接口默认只会导出合成后的产物，但如果你有需要，GUI 中有一个按钮可以允许导出$(italic)所有/$物品。$(p)$(italic)请注意，这一行为与 1.12.2 时代相比已经改变，现在对玩家友好得多。/$

Output mode $(item)Interfaces/$ will auto-eject into an adjacent inventory; this may or may not include other mods' pipes, depending on whether or not they look like an inventory to the interface.$(p)It costs 1000mL of $(l:base_concepts/pressure)air/$ per item transferred. This means, to transfer a full stack, the $(item)Interface/$ needs 64000mL (4 bar for a basic 3x3x3 chamber). If the Interface seems to get 'stuck', it's just waiting for more pressure to build up.

处于输出模式的$(item)接口/$会自动将物品弹出到相邻的容器中；这也可能包括其他模组的管道，也可能不包括，具体取决于这些管道在该接口看来是否算作容器。$(p)每传输一个物品都要消耗 1000mL 的$(l:base_concepts/pressure)空气/$。这意味着，要传输满满一组物品，$(item)接口/$需要 64000mL（对于基础的 3x3x3 压力室来说是 4 bar）。如果接口看起来像是“卡住”了，那它其实只是在等待压力进一步积累。

$(bold)Tips/$$(li)When compressing $(item)Iron/$, compress $(item)Block of Iron/$, since it will use only 1/9th of the air to move items in & out of the chamber.$(li)If you need to pressurize a large chamber quickly, extra valves can be helpful (assuming you have sufficient compressors to produce the necessary air).
$(bold)提示/$$(li)与其压缩$(item)铁锭/$，不如直接压缩$(item)铁块/$，因为这样在物品进出压力室时只需消耗 1/9 的空气。$(li)如果你需要快速给一个大型压力室加压，额外添加阀门会很有帮助（前提是你有足够的压缩机来提供所需空气）。

The $(item)Reinforced Pressure Chamber Valve/$ is an advanced block which can be used to upgrade the maximum air pressure in the Pressure Chamber from the default 5 bar to 20 bar, allowing the Pressure Chamber to store 4 times the air, and possibly unlocking $(ttcolor)$(t:By default all Pressure Chamber recipes require a max of 5 bar, but modpacks may change this)new recipes/$.
$(item)强化压力室气阀/$是一种高级方块，可用于将压力室的最大气压从默认的 5 bar 提升到 20 bar，使压力室可储存 4 倍的空气，并且还可能解锁$(ttcolor)$(t:默认情况下，所有压力室配方最高只需要 5 bar，但整合包可能会改动这一点)新合成配方/$。
Note that you don't need to upgrade any $(item)interfaces/$, $(item)walls/$, or $(item)glass/$.
注意，你不需要升级任何$(item)接口/$、$(item)墙体/$或$(item)玻璃/$。
